title: $1,000 in Nike in 1990 is now worth this
caption:
In 1990, Nike was a shoe company.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:NKE:1990-01-02} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Nike in 1990? 👇
sources: Nike price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time
